digestAlgorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 recursively key-sorted compact JSON for /contract followed by exactly one LF byte (the exact output of jq -cS '.contract')

authority.humanRuling: Founder GOAL.md requires IMPLEMENT -> PREFLIGHT -> AUDIT -> SCORE -> REPEAT until independently eligible 4/5 APPROVED, with the canonical daily-facts self-L3 active before READY-FOR-AUDIT. On 2026-08-10 the Founder explicitly relaxed qualifying topic/article material to within seven days of the workflow timestamp so the L3 test does not depend on same-day publishing volume.

founderAmendments.authority: Direct Founder ruling in the active task
founderAmendments.ruling: Topic/article candidates may be within a seven-day range of the workflow timestamp so the canonical L3 test does not depend on same-day publishing volume.
founderAmendments.interpretation: A qualifying publication date has an integer UTC age from zero through seven days inclusive relative to the run date. The report asOfDate remains the run date; future dates and dates more than seven days old fail closed.
founderAmendments.redResult: Six focused uncached RED passes each had exactly one meaningful failure: the prior same-day validator rejected the initial seven-day relaxation, the date-evidence parser rejected a valid abbreviated month, the initial calendar-window interpretation rejected an article exactly seven days old, the content validator admitted an off-topic headline, the first relevance hardening rejected a valid acronym-linked headline, and the visible-date check rejected a valid locale-formatted date

contract.contractFreezeRule: The /contract object, row identities, assertions, values, negative guarantees, target vocabulary, and cleanup obligations are immutable after this digest is published. RED evidence is recorded outside /contract.
contract.lockedGreenRule: Preserve literal shebang/public interpreter admission, JSON compatibility, SDK import exclusivity and singleton lifecycle, .pi byte identity, accepted non-daily workflow behavior, immutable audit history, and all prior contract evidence.
contract.acceptanceLimitation: Worker evidence stops at READY-FOR-AUDIT. Only fresh exact-candidate Preflight and an independent external Judge may establish eligibility or approval.

rows.runtime: Vitest with controlled abort-aware and abort-ignoring adapters
rows.testIdentity: [L1:INTEGRATION] DF-GC1-001 drains every started agent and artifact operation before one terminal event and promise settlement
rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: A failing sibling rejects while another remains active and later emits node.completed after workflow.failed; an artifact operation may also settle after terminal state.
rows.observableGreen: Failure aborts queued work, awaits all started agent/artifact operations including abort-ignoring work, classifies each node once, then emits exactly one terminal event last and settles the public promise with active work zero.
rows.countExpectation: At least two selected adversarial cases and one success-order case; zero selection fails.
rows.isolationAndCleanup: Controlled promises always release; active count and pending artifact count return to zero.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:INTEGRATION] DF-GC1-002 records only identity-bearing consumed provenance and fails closed on ambiguous equal primitive outputs
rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: Two independent equal-valued roots cause a join consuming one root to record both root IDs.
rows.observableGreen: Object identity and explicitly carried provenance record only actually consumed roots across nested and aliased inputs; ambiguous equal primitive lineage fails closed instead of manufacturing dependencies.
negativeGuarantees: never infer two producers solely from equal value digests
never silently understate a detected ambiguous primitive dependency
rows.countExpectation: Equal primitive, distinct object identity, nested alias, copied literal, and ordinary unique-output rows all execute.
rows.isolationAndCleanup: Pure in-process values; no external state.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:INTEGRATION] DF-GC1-003 redacts secret-bearing keys case-insensitively at every nesting depth
rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: token, apiKey, password, Authorization, credentials, cookie aliases, and mixed-case nested variants persist in journal JSON.
rows.observableGreen: A reviewed case-normalized structural policy redacts all sensitive-key variants while retaining bounded safe diagnostics and stable event shape.
negativeGuarantees: no seeded secret bytes in journal
rows.countExpectation: Every declared sensitive alias and mixed-case/nested variant is asserted; zero aliases is invalid.
rows.isolationAndCleanup: Unique temporary root removed in finally; zero journal temp residue.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:INTEGRATION] DF-GC1-004 serializes or rejects duplicate artifact names deterministically with unique atomic temporary files
rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: Concurrent same-name writes share a PID-only temporary path and yield one rejected/one fulfilled result with nondeterministic terminal ordering.
rows.observableGreen: Every write owns a unique temporary path, duplicate-name semantics fail closed deterministically before bytes are published, artifact errors retain storage attribution, final bytes/digest agree, and finalization prevents later writes.
negativeGuarantees: no storage failure classified as agent failure
rows.countExpectation: Success, concurrent collision, injected write failure, post-finalize attempt, and byte/digest rows execute.
rows.isolationAndCleanup: Unique temporary root removed; artifact and journal temp counts return to zero.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:INTEGRATION] DF-GC1-005 admits only exact gpt-5.6-luna with medium reasoning before adapter launch
